data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Jada means gentle, fragrant, and soft. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'J-D-D', which conveys the sense of softness and gentleness. In Islamic culture, Jada is also a name associated with the fragrance of paradise and the sweetness of faith. The name jada carries the meaning “Gentle, Fragrant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose jada usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, fragrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
